label: Boat-shaped 2.8 cm
description: The boat-shaped breast pocket at 2.8 cm refers to a welt pocket whose opening traces a shallow crescent — wider at the centre and rising toward both ends — that closely resembles the hull of a small dinghy. At 2.8 cm it is a confidently sized barchetta, typically associated with the boldest Neapolitan tailors who want the pocket to be an expressive design element rather than a quiet utility feature. The curved form follows the chest's natural contour and is considered by many connoisseurs to be the most flattering breast pocket shape for displaying a pocket square.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
